purpose: Discover and exact-byte lock the trustworthy original ONSure Phase A D01-D22 artifact before any D23 or Golden comparison. Similar, reconstructed, non-blind, or later-modified artifacts are not substitutable.
search_scope: ORUDA Git refs, history, reflogs, and unreachable blobs
GitHub babyandi/ORUDA PR #950 metadata, changed-file inventory, and discussion timeline
GitHub babyandi/ORUDA remote branch search for ONSure branches

assessment: The PR description says the actual blind generative replay/independent reconstruction was NOT_RUN at the initial method-validation boundary.
PR discussion comment 5231304704 explicitly classifies the preflight as NONBLIND because the session had already seen Golden-related context.
PR discussion comment 5231467298 describes OBUILDER_ONSURE_PHASE_A_SEMANTIC_REPLAY.candidate.v1.0.0.json as a new Phase A artifact created during semantic replay, not preserved original bytes.

PR discussion comment 5231517499 defines the intended order as Phase A freeze, isolated Phase B freeze, post-freeze D23, then Golden; it does not supply a pre-Golden original Phase A identity receipt.

remote_branch_search.baseline_branch_assessment: No ONSure Phase A, D01-D22 freeze, D23, or associated provenance receipt/manifest file is present on the baseline branch.

reasons: It is a 98-line preflight catalog and does not contain 22 individually frozen semantic_artifacts for D01-D22.
Its coverage list includes D23 rather than representing only frozen D01-D22 output.
The Golden Corpus commit 41807242226b0656e7edb7605d27ac4b18eb8bd0 is an ancestor of the freeze commit, so pre-Golden-publication provenance is not established.
No independent freeze/execution receipt binds these exact bytes and establishes pre-Golden isolation.
The artifact purpose explicitly says it is a Phase A re-run after semantic-pass gate hardening.
The artifact explicitly says it is non-blind and cannot satisfy independent reconstruction.
The Golden Corpus commit is an ancestor of this replay commit.
A later semantic replay cannot substitute for the exact bytes of the original Phase A run.
The receipt points to the non-blind semantic replay and archetype evidence, not an independently preserved original Phase A artifact.
The receipt does not bind the referenced files by SHA-256 or Git blob.
The receipt explicitly says blind replay effect is NONE.

decision.next_action: Locate an independently preserved original Phase A D01-D22 artifact and a receipt or manifest that binds its exact SHA-256/Git identity and establishes freeze before Golden exposure.
